dashboard.label: TA-webtools Curl Test Harness
dashboard.description: Test curl command syntax and features

html.div:
Correct Syntax:
| curl urifield=<field_name> [method=<method>] [data=<data>] [debug=true]
Note: Original curl.py requires HTTPS for all external requests (Splunk Cloud compliance).

search.query: | makeresults | eval url="$test1_url$" | curl urifield=url | table curl_status, curl_uri, curl_method
| makeresults | eval url="$test2_url$", data="$test2_data$" | curl urifield=url method=post data="$test2_data$" | table curl_status, curl_method, curl_data_payload
| makeresults | eval url="$test3_url$" | curl urifield=url debug=true | table curl_status, curl_uri, curl_method, curl_verifyssl
| makeresults | eval url="$test4_url$" | curl urifield=url | table curl_status, len(curl_message) as message_length | eval preview=substr(curl_message,1,200)
| makeresults | eval url="https://httpbin.org/$test5_method$" | curl urifield=url method=$test5_method$ | table curl_status, curl_method

div.style: background: #1a472a; padding: 15px; border: 1px solid #2d6b42; border-radius: 5px; margin-top: 20px;

ul.li: ✓ All HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) supported
⚠ HTTPS required for all external requests (Splunk Cloud compliance)
⚠ Local/loopback interfaces require HTTPS or special configuration

div.p: PR #41 Features (dryrun, clean, methodfield, redirect tracking) require the refactored curl.py which has compatibility issues. Consider merging those features carefully into the original.
